source.basis: Explicit pinned upstream source test invocations and assertions; no upstream binary was executed and no live Google data are represented.

cases.name: compact_source_assertions
cases.difference_note: Pinned upstream contract builder accepts one supplied object yet independently reports 25 returned rows. Native compact mode constructs a 25-tuple compact object from 25 synthetic provider rows; compare shared metadata, not full payload equality.

cases.name: summary_only_source_assertions
cases.difference_note: Both normalize data to null. Upstream source test supplies one row with independent metadata reporting five; native derives returned count from five fixture provider rows.

negative_parity_findings.note: Policy-denial category and detail from pinned source are not established as an equivalent native path; do not count this as matched error parity.

Native CursorQueryMismatch now maps an otherwise well-formed cursor with another property's or query's SHA-256 to CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH / invalid_cursor / cursor. Malformed cursor syntax and other pagination error classifications still differ from upstream; complete T157/T171 parity remains open.

excluded: elapsed_ms: pinned upstream builder measures caller-supplied real value (8/9), native explicitly reports 0 as an unmeasured sentinel
Upstream's supplied data array and native generated compact representation differ; not flattened into false equality
Upstream source assertions do not prove binary runtime, Google API or all tool outputs
